icapResource.title: ICAP resource
icapResource.description: Shared ICAP resource on the gateway.

banner.title: Policy Placement
banner.text: Phase (request phase vs response phase) is discovered automatically from where you place this policy in Policy Studio.

executionMode.title: Execution mode
executionMode.description: Synchronous waits for the ICAP verdict before continuing. Asynchronous forwards content immediately and scans in the background.

detectOnly.title: Detection only
detectOnly.description: Log infected content without blocking the request (synchronous mode only).

failClosedOnIcapError.title: Fail closed on ICAP error
failClosedOnIcapError.description: Return HTTP 500 when ICAP is unavailable or returns an error (synchronous mode).

blockStatusCode.title: Block status code
blockStatusCode.description: HTTP status returned when infected content is blocked in synchronous mode.

blockMessage.title: Block message
blockMessage.description: Message returned to the client when infected content is blocked.
blockMessage.default: Request blocked by ICAP content scan

enableContentModification.title: Enable content modification
enableContentModification.description: Apply sanitized or repaired body content returned by the ICAP server in synchronous mode. Requires an ICAP service that supports content modification.

treatModificationAsClean.title: Treat modification as clean
treatModificationAsClean.description: When enabled, ICAP content modifications are treated as clean and the flow continues. When disabled, a modification is handled like a threat (block or detect-only).

webhookEnabled.title: Enable webhook
webhookEnabled.description: Send HTTP webhook notifications for ICAP scan results in both synchronous and asynchronous modes.

webhookOn.title: Webhook triggers
webhookOn.description: ICAP verdicts that trigger a webhook when webhook is enabled.

webhook.title: Webhook
webhook.description: Webhook URL, method, headers, timeout, retry count, and optional payload template.

payloadTemplate.title: Payload template
payloadTemplate.description: (Optional) When blank, the policy sends a built-in JSON payload with ICAP verdict and request metadata (verdict, threatName, bodySha256, etc.). When set, this string replaces that default entirely - see documentation for more information.

scanMode.title: Scan mode
scanMode.description: AUTO uses RFC 3507 preview-then-continue; QUICK scans preview bytes only; FULL sends the entire body.

banner.title: Advanced Settings
banner.text: Scan mode/depth, body limits, ICAP header forwarding, content-modification details, and asynchronous side effects.

previewBytes.title: Preview bytes
previewBytes.description: Preview size used by QUICK and AUTO scan modes.

maxBodyBytes.title: Max body bytes
maxBodyBytes.description: Maximum request/response body buffered for ICAP scanning.

failClosedOnOversizeBody.title: Fail closed on oversize body
failClosedOnOversizeBody.description: Return HTTP 413 when the body exceeds max body bytes instead of skipping the scan.

modificationParseFailureAction.title: Modification parse failure action
modificationParseFailureAction.description: Action when ICAP returns modified content that cannot be parsed.

modifiableRequestHeaders.title: Modifiable request headers
modifiableRequestHeaders.description: Request headers the policy may update when ICAP returns modified content.

modifiableResponseHeaders.title: Modifiable response headers
modifiableResponseHeaders.description: Response headers the policy may update when ICAP returns modified content.

forwardedRequestHeaders.title: Forwarded request headers
forwardedRequestHeaders.description: Request headers included in encapsulated ICAP HTTP metadata for REQMOD scans.

forwardedResponseHeaders.title: Forwarded response headers
forwardedResponseHeaders.description: Response headers included in encapsulated ICAP HTTP metadata for RESPMOD scans.

asyncOnThreat.title: Async threat actions
asyncOnThreat.description: Side effects when a threat is detected in asynchronous mode.
